settings.body: A six-stage framework that brings policy, people, testing, technology and records into one program that can be applied consistently and improved over time.
settings.trust_line: Andatech is Australia's leading drug and alcohol testing specialist since 2003.

settings.title: Understand
settings.subtitle: Workplace context
settings.description: Define who is tested, where testing happens, when it is triggered and which operating requirements shape the program.
settings.checklist:
Sites, roles and operating conditions documented
Testing triggers and relevant requirements understood
Capability gaps and responsible owners identified

settings.title: Design
settings.subtitle: Policy and procedures
settings.description: Turn workplace requirements into a clear policy, testing process, escalation pathway and set of assigned responsibilities. Select fit-for-purpose testing devices, consumables and calibration options for the agreed scope.
settings.outcome_title: Policy and procedures align with the workplace.
settings.checklist:
Program objectives and scope agreed
Collection and escalation procedures documented
Responsibilities assigned to the right people
Testing devices and consumables selected for the operating environment

settings.title: Prepare
settings.subtitle: People and rollout
settings.description: Train collectors and supervisors through appropriate pathways including nationally recognised HLTPAT010 training where required. Prepare equipment, calibration schedules and each site before testing begins.
settings.outcome_title: People and sites are ready to begin.
settings.checklist:
Collectors trained through HLTPAT010 or appropriate pathways
Workers receive clear program communication
Sites, equipment and consumables prepared
Calibration and servicing schedules established

settings.title: Execute
settings.subtitle: Testing in practice
settings.description: Run testing with suitable devices, documented collection steps and a consistent response to results.
settings.checklist:
Suitable testing methods and devices in use
Collection steps applied consistently
Results follow the documented response pathway

settings.title: Connect
settings.subtitle: Records and visibility
settings.description: Bring relevant testing, device and service records into one secure and consistent reporting view through Andalink where appropriate.
settings.outcome_title: Program records are easier to see and manage.
settings.checklist:
Relevant records connected where appropriate
Service and calibration status visible
Reporting supports review and audit preparation

settings.title: Improve
settings.subtitle: Review and improvement
settings.description: Review program activity and keep calibration, training, procedures and improvement actions current as the workplace changes.
settings.outcome_title: The program stays current as the workplace changes.
settings.checklist:
Program activity reviewed regularly
Training and service schedules kept current
Improvements assigned and followed through

settings.heading: Six stages.
settings.description: Move from workplace context to a program that stays current as people, sites and requirements change.

settings.heading: Efficient
settings.text: Reduce avoidable manual handoffs and make relevant program information easier to find.

settings.heading: Auditable
settings.text: Bring device, service and testing records into a clearer evidence structure.

settings.heading: Sustainable
settings.text: Support calibration, review and follow-up rhythms as operations change.

settings.heading: Testing is valuable when you can manage
settings.desc: Connected records can make a workplace testing program easier to operate, review and improve.

settings.heading: Now choose the level of support.
settings.description: Compare what a program can include and choose the operational approach that best complements your team.
